title: Dynamic Alerting Platform — Routing Profiles Schema (ADR-007)
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for validating _routing_profiles.yaml. Defines reusable named routing configurations that tenants reference via _routing_profile.
$comment: Add to VS Code settings.json: "yaml.schemas": { "./docs/schemas/routing-profiles.schema.json": "conf.d/_routing_profiles.yaml" }. #2245: a profile is shallow-merged into the tenant's _routing and rendered by the same route generator, so its shape IS the tenant routing definition — referenced, not copied (the copy that lived here had drifted and described `routes` the generator never rendered). Resolves against this file's $id, which shares its base with tenant-config.schema.json's $id — so a validator must load BOTH schemas into its registry / schema store (e.g. jsonschema's referencing.Registry keyed by each $id); loading this file alone leaves the $ref unresolvable.

routing_profiles.title: Routing Profiles Map
routing_profiles.description: Mapping of profile-name to routing configuration. Naming convention: team-{team}-{region} or domain-{domain}-{tier}. Each profile is Layer 2 of the four-layer merge: it overrides _routing_defaults and is overridden key by key (shallow) by the tenant's _routing.
